The rewritten Version-parity sentence hard-codes `@v1.4.2` as the exemplar pin — two minors behind this file's own `version: "1.6.2"` frontmatter (published tags now reach v1.6.2+), so a first-time reader copies a stale pin out of a paragraph this PR just rewrote. A tag-agnostic phrasing can't go stale at the next release. The same staleness also survives in the moved Install block (lines 98 and 107) — byte-identical moves, but worth refreshing in the same pass.

## Verdict

Clean docs-only rework — every factual claim I checked against the codebase holds. One stale-version nit; nothing blocking.

## What I verified

This PR's value is narrative accuracy for first-time readers, so I fact-checked the new claims rather than just reading the prose:

- **`prompt-extension-file: .review/extension.md`** (intro + Flow B paragraph) — real input at `action.yml:54`; the local↔CI parity wiring described is accurate.
- **"enforced by CI's `Skills — prompt-sync invariant` job"** — the job exists with that exact name (`.github/workflows/code_check.yml:86`) and diffs `prompt.md` against `prompts/default.md`.
- **Compressed Parity-guarantee (Flow B) paragraph lost no information** — cross-checked against `setup/SKILL.md` Step 5: **yes** → `prompt-extension-file` added to the freshly-composed workflow; **no** → stop after Step 4 (input omitted). The compressed text preserves both directions plus the recovery paths.
- **Removed "First-time bootstrap" paragraph was truly duplicated** — the yes/no/never semantics and the `.review/.skip-bootstrap` opt-out marker are fully specified in Step 2.5 (`skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md:285-336`) and the Notes section (`skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md:505-509`). Nothing lost.
- **"Steps 0-5 and Notes are byte-identical"** — confirmed via hunk inspection against the merge base (`7f75f05`): the last hunk ends at the new "Default flow" header; everything below is untouched.
- **Sibling links resolve** — `generate-extension/SKILL.md`, `setup/SKILL.md`, `open-pr/SKILL.md`, `setup/reference.md`, and `prompt.md` all exist at the linked relative paths.
- **Frontmatter stays valid** — the new `&` in `description:` sits mid-scalar (YAML-safe; parses cleanly with a real YAML parser), `version: "1.6.2"` is still SemVer, and `allowed-tools` / `user-invocable` / `metadata` are untouched — all `scripts/validate-frontmatter.py` requirements still satisfied.
- **Security/convention scan of the new content** — no fetch-a
